constraints: sheet is 0-based; if omitted or -1 is passed, the command applies to the current sheet.
A table theme can be set via VP CREATE TABLE, VP SET TABLE THEME, or the interface.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the current theme property values of tableName as a cs.ViewPro.TableTheme object.

sentinelValues.meaning: Same as omitting the parameter: applies to the current sheet.
